name: test-strength
brief: Strengthen eight tests in src/DungeonMaster.Tests that cannot fail on the defect they guard (backlog .sir/backlog.md:102-105,109,110,112,113; S1-S8). All eight re-measured live at e22840e. Seven sequential test-engineer tasks, one test file each: the IsInEnum-only validator rejects 999; the ObjectKind ordinal test pins WeaponRack == 37; the MutationOutcome.None arm is pinned by its message; the handler token is captured on each behaviour-present dispatch path; AddPlacedObject asserts a 2.0 scale; the invalid-scale message assertion pins the range sentence instead of Contain("5"); Floor.Objects caching places an object, and all five cached wrappers get a read-mutate-reread test. Each new assertion is shown red under a named, reverted, cmp-verified production injection with a control that stays green. No production code is committed.
